samples.name: Glance Sample App (root)
samples.description: Full sample app: landing, home (Simple Session / Advanced / Guides), Simple Session screen, Advanced (TestAppView) with presence/video/timeouts/masking, Hosted tab, Log tab. Use this as the integration guide. List files with get_file_by_path(platform='ios', repo='default_ui', relative_path='.examples/glance-sample-app/glance-sample-app/<file>.swift').

samples.name: GlanceManager (central API wrapper)
samples.description: Singleton wrapper for all GlanceDefaultUI and Glance core calls: setVisitorParams (full signature with timeout, maxConnectAttempts, fetchSettingsInterval, isDefaultPresenceIntegrationEnabled, isDefaultTwoWayVideoIntegration, isDefaultRenderModeIntegration), setPresence, startSession(key:timeout:videoMode:), endSession, startHostedSession, stopHostedSession, pause, togglePause, pausePresence. Use this pattern so view models call GlanceManager.shared instead of GlanceDefaultUI directly.

samples.name: TestAppViewModel (full GlanceUIDelegate)
samples.description: Implements GlanceUIDelegate and GlanceLoggerDelegate. In init(): GlanceDefaultUI.setDelegate(self), Glance.setLoggerDelegate(self). startSession() and startSessionRandomKey(): build GlanceVisitorInitParams (groupid, visitorid, video), optional timeouts and GlanceTimeout, then GlanceManager.shared.setVisitorParams(...) with all integration flags, then GlanceManager.shared.startSession(...). onPresenceTapped(): setPresence then setVisitorParams. onError: sets errorCode, errorMessage, showAlertDialog = true. presenceDidConnect/presenceDidDisconnect update isPresenceConnected. All 30 delegate methods implemented (logging or state). Reference for presence, video, timeouts, and error handling.

samples.name: TestAppView (Advanced session UI)
samples.description: Tab-based UI: Advanced Session (group ID, visitor ID, key, video mode, Presence toggle, timeouts, fetch settings interval, render mode, masking, pause), Log tab, Hosted tab. onAppear: Glance.maskKeyboard(true), Glance.setDrawViewHierarchy for render option, viewModel.setDelegate(), optional onPresenceTapped/onVideoTapped. Camera: AVCaptureDevice.authorizationStatus and requestAccess(for: .video); show alert if !authorized. Alert for viewModel.showAlertDialog (onError). Builds session start view, timeouts view, masking links (TestMaskingViewController, TestMaskingView, TestWebViewController).

samples.name: HostedViewModel
samples.description: Hosted session only. init(): GlanceDefaultUI.setDelegate(self). toggleHostedSession(username:password:): if active stopHostedSession else startHostedSession. Implements GlanceUIDelegate with empty bodies for all methods except hostedSessionDidStart (stores sessionKey, isHostedSessionActive = true) and hostedSessionDidEnd (if !errorMessage.isEmpty sets errorMessage and showAlertDialog = true; else clears sessionKey and sets isHostedSessionActive = false). setDelegate() called from HostedView.onAppear. Reference for hosted session and error handling.

samples.name: HostedView
samples.description: SwiftUI view: username, password, server fields; Start/Stop button calling viewModel.toggleHostedSession(username:password:). Displays session key when viewModel.sessionKey is set. onAppear: viewModel.setDelegate(). Alert with GlanceLocalizedStringsConstants.dialogErrorTitle, dialogErrorPrimaryButton, dialogErrorSecondaryButton when viewModel.showAlertDialog (hostedSessionDidEnd with error).

samples.name: SimpleSessionViewModel (minimal start)
samples.description: Minimal visitor-initiated session: GlanceVisitorInitParams with groupid only, GlanceManager.shared.setVisitorParams(params), GlanceManager.shared.startSession(key: sessionKey, videoMode: VideoOff). No presence, no video, no timeouts. Good reference for basic start flow.

samples.name: SimpleSessionView
samples.description: UI for SimpleSessionViewModel: Group ID and Session Key fields, Start button, description text. Calls viewModel.startSession() on tap.

samples.name: TestMaskingViewController (UIView masking)
samples.description: UIKit: UITextField, UILabel, UIButton. In setupMasking(): Glance.addMaskedView(textField, withLabel: 'Masked text field'), Glance.addMaskedView(label, withLabel: 'Masked label'), Glance.addMaskedView(button, withLabel: 'Masked button'). Add Mask View button adds MaskingTestView subview. Reference for native UIView masking.

samples.name: TestMaskingView (SwiftUI masking)
samples.description: SwiftUI: TextField, Text, Button with .addMaskedView(withLabel: '...') modifier. Reference for SwiftUI content masking (GlanceSDK MaskedViewModifier).

samples.name: TestWebViewController (WebView masking)
samples.description: GlanceMaskContentController with CSS selectors and labels (e.g. '.mask_1', '.mask_2', '#mask_3'), set on WKWebViewConfiguration.userContentController, create WKWebView with that config, add to view, then glanceMaskContentController.setWebView(maskingWebView). Load URL. When the WebView is in a tab or off-screen, set webView.isHidden = true when not visible and isHidden = false when visible so masking behaves correctly. Reference for WebView content masking.

samples.name: AppCoordinator (navigation)
samples.description: Navigation: start() -> showLandingScreenView -> showHomeView (Simple Session / Advanced / Guides). showSimpleSessionView pushes SimpleSessionView; showTestAppView pushes TestAppView (Hosted tab inside); showInfoView, showGuidesView (TestWebViewController for help URL), showTestWebMaskingView(url), showTestMaskingView (TestMaskingViewController), showTestMaskingSwiftUIView (TestMaskingView). Toast: presentToolbarMessage. Shows where setDelegate and Glance screens are triggered in app structure.

samples.name: GlanceHomeView
samples.description: Home screen with options: Simple Session, Advanced, Guides. Fires navigationEvents for AppCoordinator.

samples.name: GlanceHomeViewModel
samples.description: ViewModel for GlanceHomeView; navigation events for simpleSession, advanced, guides.

samples.name: GlanceLandingScreenView
samples.description: Landing screen; triggers showHomeView.

samples.name: LogView
samples.description: Log tab: displays SDK messages, events, errors, diagnostic (from TestAppViewModel GlanceUIDelegate and GlanceLoggerDelegate). Share logs via Glance.logFilePath.

samples.name: MaskingTestView
samples.description: Custom view used in TestMaskingViewController addMaskView; can contain additional masked subviews.

samples.name: SceneDelegate
samples.description: Scene lifecycle; calls appCoordinator?.start() to begin navigation.

samples.name: AppDelegate
samples.description: App delegate; configures window and scene.

samples.name: create_xcframework.sh
samples.description: Script to build GlanceSDK as XCFramework: archive for Simulator and Device, then xcodebuild -create-xcframework with both frameworks. Use when integrating via XCFrameworks instead of SPM.

sample_repo_root: PublicRepo/glance-default-ui-ios-releases (or GLANCE_SDK_REPO_ROOT). Paths in samples are relative to this repo. Use get_file_by_path(platform='ios', repo='default_ui', relative_path=<path>) to fetch file content.
find_sample_usage: find_sample(flow_id='start-session') or find_sample(method_id='GlanceDefaultUI.setVisitorParams') or find_sample(keyword='hosted') returns matching samples; then use get_file_by_path to read the path.
